title: CB3D13 self-anchored suspension, balanced side span + erection stages vs ANSYS
description: 60 nodes / 83 elements, 26 main-cable segments + 23 hangers; side_span=0 -> auto balanced L_bal=sqrt(2*H*dz_top/q)=71.414284 m. [A] Full-bridge completion: design geometry D=[ERECTED]+[U], per-cable absolute L0 -> INISTATE. [B] Anchor vertical component V~0 so girder ends need no uplift restraint. [C] cable_solver *ERECTION 6 stages (5 with load); per stage a LINK180 main-span cable chain is solved from a 0.20 m perturbed geometry with stage-specific unstrained lengths L0=L_stage/(1+T_stage/EA) and stage hanger loads.
reference_source: ANSYS 18.0 batch results frozen in cases/*_ansys_*.csv and cases/*_stage*_*.csv; generated by BridgeStudio/ansys_bridge_susp.py, ansys_bridge_nl.py and ansys_bridge_erection.py from the same ModelSpec3D + FEM form-finding result
geometry_note: Full bridge: ANSYS initial geometry = design geometry D = [ERECTED] + [U], per-cable absolute L0 -> INISTATE. Erection stages: ANSYS initial geometry = FEM stage shape + 0.20 m sinusoidal perturbation; stage unstrained length L0_stage = L_stage/(1+T_stage/EA) injected per LINK180 segment.

csv_label.link: LINK180 axial force SMISC 1 (full bridge, tension only)
csv_label.stage_disp: UX/UY/UZ of the main-span main-cable chain
csv_label.stage_link: LINK180 axial force SMISC 1 (main-span cable segments)

stage_csv_label.disp: UX/UY/UZ of the main-span main-cable chain
stage_csv_label.link: LINK180 axial force SMISC 1 (main-span cable segments)

skipped_reason: stage 0 (empty cable) hits the H bisection lower bound 100 N with sag=0; a Load-free LINK180 chain is a mechanism, so it is recorded but not cross-checked against ANSYS.
tolerance: |got-ref| <= atol + rtol*scale, rtol=2e-3; scale is the per-group max(|FEM|,|ANSYS|), identical to compare_susp() and compare_erection()

balance_expect.note: L_bal = sqrt(2*H0*dz_top/q); side_span=0 asks the generator to use it. V=0 at the girder-end anchor means no uplift restraint is needed; CB3D12 with a manual 40 m side span needs -872.621 kN (uplift) at each end.

derived.stage_H: mean over k of T[k]*|x[k+1]-x[k]|/L[k], with x = chain_x + disp_csv[i][0] (UX)
